cues.text: A sixty-seven-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis falls when walking back from town.
The X-ray shows an intracapsular fracture of the femoral neck.
In elderly patients, hemiarthroplasty is indicated for intracapsular fractures,
unless there is a diseased acetabulum, when a total hip replacement is preferred.
Here, rheumatoid arthritis affects both hips, so the operation is a total hip replacement.
